decisions.statement: A picture made from committed pages alone is a file change the landing carries.
Such a picture is drawn from the change rather than from the pages on disk.
A picture drawn the same as the one already filed is no file change.
The picture already filed is read from the working tree, because no commit holds it.
A change no shadow can be cast over draws nothing rather than refusing.
A drawing that throws is said rather than thrown, and the landing goes on.
A picture the change cannot have moved is not drawn.
A change moving no picture casts no shadow.
A picture here is made by reading every page of many page types.

definition: the pictures a landing carries, drawn from the change rather than from the disk
